hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.env.example|*.env.sample) exit 0;; *.env|*.env.*) echo 'Refusing to edit real .env files (use .env.example)' >&2; exit 2;; esac

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); echo "$c" | grep -Eq 'git +commit' && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD | grep -Eqx 'main|master' && { echo 'Refusing to commit on main; use a feature branch' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
